content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: On sales invoice:new, each Save click is followed by a visible validation error (cited 599 then 600:e622, 661 then 663:e691, 606 then 607:e668, 668 then 670:e733), and the user edits Due Date (344, 348) and other fields between attempts, which suggests Save validation rejects a field that is not marked as invalid before Save.", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new screen, when Save fails validation, scroll to and focus the first invalid field (Due Date, Item Code, Qty or Rate) and show its inline error next to that field, not only the top-level visible error message.", "cited_event_ids": ["344", "348", "599", "600:e622", "606", "607:e668", "661", "663:e691", "668", "670:e733"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text of the validation message and the name of the invalid field are not in the events.", "Which field fails validation on each Save is not shown; the fix names candidate fields only.", "Event windows show pointer and click events only, so whether the error is cleared or persists after edits is not confirmed."]}
